name: Radiation Effects & Nuclear Materials
summary: Explains how neutrons, ions and energetic particles damage materials and which materials survive in fission reactors, fusion devices and space.

topics.name: Radiation-matter interactions: neutrons, ions, electrons and gamma rays
Displacement damage: primary knock-on atoms, cascades and dpa
Radiation-induced point defects, loops and voids
Radiation hardening and embrittlement (DBTT shift in pressure vessel steels)
Void swelling, irradiation creep and irradiation growth
Fission fuel materials: UO2, MOX and accident-tolerant fuels
Cladding and core materials: zirconium alloys, stainless steels and ODS steels
Fusion materials: plasma-facing tungsten, reduced-activation steels and breeder blankets
Radiation effects in polymers, ceramics and semiconductors
